title: Brand mention
content: A brand mention occurs when an AI answer names a brand, which is a separate observation from a source link to that brand’s site.

meta.why: A link to a brand's site and a mention of the brand's name turn up independently. One answer can have either without the other.
meta.example: An answer names Acme but links only to a trade publication, so we would record a mention for Acme and a citation for the publication.
meta.check: Save separate yes/no fields for brand named and owned domain cited in each sampled answer.
meta.limitation: Counting conventions vary, and Ahrefs, for one, counts a brand once per response even when its name appears several times.
meta.sources: Ahrefs: AI visibility metrics | https://help.ahrefs.com/en/articles/15501968-ai-visibility-metrics | Vendor documentation
